repository.source_identity_note: capture_revision identifies the live-capture source, candidate_revision identifies the immutable executable candidate actually profiled, handoff_revision identifies the evidence-generation source, and correction_revision identifies the later validator/closure-evidence correction. The live binaries, preserved NVBit DSO, simulator, and cards are bound by the recorded SHA-256 values; metadata corrections must not be mistaken for a new silicon capture.

source_equivalence.method: clean detached worktree build at repository candidate_revision; candidate and reviewed release binaries are byte-identical

evidence_bundle.materialization: The same evidence/raw/ tree is present in this alpha worktree for immediate inspection. From the campaign directory in a clean checkout, run: zstd -dc evidence/raw_cohort.tar.zst | tar -xf - -C evidence. Per-cell replay_binding.json sidecars bind replay bytes to the exact simulator binary and all replay inputs, so timestamp manipulation is neither required nor used.

command_normalization.paths: Executable argv paths are repository-relative; campaign artifact paths are relative to this manifest's directory. The executions were first captured in bounded temporary directories and copied byte-for-byte into evidence/raw before this manifest was written.
command_normalization.geometry_policy: expected_grid/expected_block are the committed workload launch geometry and are independently cross-checked against NCU launch__grid/block/thread_count, NVBit stats, and the d_*.pb payload population before replay coverage is accepted.
command_normalization.ncu_policy: NCU and NVBit were separate processes; NCU values are comparison targets only and never simulator inputs.
command_normalization.trace_policy: Portable LCD runners require ACTIVE_FROM_START=1; the profiler-marked async research probe uses ACTIVE_FROM_START=0.
command_normalization.runtime_policy: capture_sm86_nvbit.py authenticates tracer/runtime closure with retained descriptors; logical env is recorded separately from descriptor-backed effective env.

observed.enhanced_parser: typed skip for generated input over 64KiB

limitations: Matched NCU and simulator stages both use 64 groups; only the separate 16,384-group scaling observation uses 16,384 groups.
NCU traffic is represented by kernel-local L1TEX global-load/store request-sector counters; aggregate DRAM/LTS counters include prewarm traffic and are not used as async-kernel labels.

closure.mechanism: The measured SM-active/GPC envelopes include launch and dirty-writeback/coherence retirement behavior that the typed event frontier does not model; async/barrier readiness is observable but not uniquely separable from those tails.
closure.next_discriminator: A matched store-free/barrier-free async-source pair with an independent retirement observable.
